scope: Windows production dispatcher and provider client with an isolated SQLite profile and authenticated synthetic HTTP on localhost

cases.observed: The edit response confirmed issue 55 in the healthy control. After rollback the cached title stayed original and no own-action receipt was published. Authenticated restart did not replay the edit or declare success.
An acknowledged comment ID survived rollback. The restarted worker read back that exact comment on the original issue.
The original pending review receipt survived. One create and one submit occurred in total. Readback confirmed the same review, actor, event and original head.

The acknowledged merge OID survived the rollback of the authoritative readback transaction. The cached PR stayed unmerged until a second read verified the exact PR, head, original actor and acknowledged OID. It recorded one own merge.

restart_boundary: The original worker stopped and released its SQLite connections. The fixture reopened the same file and used a fresh HTTP client with the same synthetic credential. Only the elapsed readback deadline was advanced. Immutable intent, item, repository and attempt count stayed unchanged.

portable_regressions.scope: Linux x64 local checkout f8e003d with the applied test patch
